purpose: Remember the things you mean to do until you have done them.

actions.name: addTodo
actions.description: Add a todo with this text; it starts not done.

actions.name: completeTodo
refuses: a todo that does not exist

actions.name: deleteTodo
actions.description: Remove this todo from the list, and its tags with it.
refuses: a todo that does not exist

near_miss: a list where ticking a todo deletes it, so you can never see what you finished
misfits: a long list with no way to clear the finished todos

purpose: Group todos by a word you choose, so you can see which belong together.

actions.name: addTag
actions.description: Tag this todo with a word.
refuses: a todo that does not exist
the same tag twice on one todo

actions.name: removeTag
actions.description: Take this tag off its todo.
refuses: a tag that does not exist

near_miss: a tag you can only set when the todo is made, so you can never regroup a todo
misfits: a tag with a typo cannot be renamed, only removed and added again
